title: Evaluation of the Clinical Benefit of the Aktiia Blood Pressure Monitoring for Early Awareness of Hypertension and Prediction of Cardiovascular Risk
official: OBPM_FORESEE2024: Evaluation of the Clinical Benefit of the Aktiia Blood Pressure Monitoring for Early Awareness of Hypertension and Prediction of Cardiovascular Risk in a Multi-ethnic European Population: an Observational Cohorts' Study
summary: Because Aktiia S.A. has been the first-ever company to put in the market an Optical Blood Pressure Monitoring device, there is a need for Aktiia S.A. to correlate for the first time continual Blood Pressure monitoring and the evolution of environmental and health factors to improve hypertension management.

interventions.name: Unlimited on-demand blood pressure measurements with G2C
Continual blood pressure measurements with G1

sites.f: Fully remote study- no physical investigational site
